formal_statement: ∀ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 5 × Fin 5 → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ L, (∑ f : Fin 5 ↪ Fin 5, ∏ i, (1 + t (i, f i))) = 120) → Module.finrank ℂ L ≤ 8
plain_statement: SMALL CASE, possibly false: every linear space L of 5 x 5 complex matrices on which the sum over all permutations f of the product of (1 + t(i, f(i))) stays equal to 120, its value at t = 0 (equivalently all sums of k x k subpermanents of t vanish on L), has dimension at most 8. The largest dimension known to us is 7 (unchecked). A refutation is an explicit such space of dimension 9. The statement needs only the pinned library.
title: Small case at five rows: a level space of 5 x 5 complex matrices has dimension at most 8
